One of the 9 hymns that are printed in the Stavamaṇimālā as Sarasvatī Vilāsa Series 6 (ed. Subrahmanya Sastri)

Written at the instance of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. See Raghavan, Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: pg. 41.
Here, Rāma's omnipotence is described and his arrows are eulogised, in Sragdharā metre (see Sinhā pg. 306–307)
Printed in Kāvyamālā Gucchaka 12 and Stavamaṇimālā, Sarasvatī Vilāsa Series 6
